in_sanskrit.name: Maithily
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Mother of the Earth
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Maithily एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Maithily is derived from the Sanskrit word 'maithuna', which means union or togetherness. This name signifies the mother of the earth, nourishing and providing for all living beings.

in_marathi.name: Maithily
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Mother of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Maithily हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Maithily is derived from the Sanskrit word 'maithuna', which means union or togetherness. This name signifies the mother of the earth, nourishing and providing for all living beings.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Mother of the Earth
